Overview


  • The study consists of two tasks and a survey.
  • You will receive a fixed compensation of £1.30 for finalizing the study including survey questions after the two tasks.
  • In the two tasks, you can earn an additional bonus between £0.00 and £2.00.
  • Your final earnings depend on your decision, the decision of the other person (with whom you are matched), and partly on chance.
  • During the study, we use tokens instead of GBP, with the exchange rate being: £1.00 = 100 tokens.


  • In the first two tasks, you will be randomly matched with another study participant.
  • Your identity will remain anonymous and likewise you won’t learn with whom you are matched at any point.

Before you are matched with the other person you will first learn about Task 1, and you have time to try out the task.

Task 1


  • You and the other person will complete the same ball-catching task.
  • If you complete the task for the entire duration of 60 seconds, you will earn 200 tokens.

There will be a task box in the middle of the screen like the one shown below:


  • Once you click on the “Start the Task!” button, the timer will start and balls will fall randomly from the top of the task box.
  • You can move the tray at the bottom of the task box to catch the balls by using the mouse to click on the LEFT or RIGHT buttons.
  • To catch a ball, your tray must be below the ball before it touches the bottom of the tray.
  • When the ball touches the tray your catches increase by one.

Your Score


  • For each mouse click you make you will incur a cost of {{ Constants.cost }} points.
  • For each ball you catch, you will receive a reward of {{ Constants.reward }} points.
  • The number of balls you have caught so far (displayed as CATCHES) and the number of clicks you have made so far (CLICKS) will be shown right above the task box.
  • Also shown above the task box will be the cumulative REWARDS, which is CATCHES multiplied by the reward per catch, and cumulative COSTS, which is CLICKS multiplied by the cost per click.

  • At the end of the period your SCORE in the task will be your REWARDS minus your COSTS.
  • Catching more balls by moving the tray more often does not necessarily lead to a higher SCORE because both REWARDS and COSTS matter for your SCORE.
  • Please note that you will earn 200 tokens, if you complete the decisive round for the entire duration of 60 seconds irrespective of your SCORE.

If you are ready, please click the "Next" button to begin with the practice round.
You can practice for up to 60 seconds.
